description: Key terms and concepts from the Sezzle Buy Now Pay Later API.

terms.definition: A transient checkout context created by the merchant that may initiate an order checkout and/or customer tokenization. Identified by a session UUID.
A purchase agreement between a shopper and merchant processed through Sezzle. An order progresses through checkout, authorization, capture, and optionally release or refund states.
A Sezzle shopper who has been tokenized for future merchant-initiated purchases. Identified by a customer UUID.
A short-lived credential representing a merchant or customer session used to retrieve customer UUIDs for future orders.
An HTTP callback subscription that delivers Sezzle event notifications (e.g. order.authorized) to a merchant-specified URL.
A settlement summary representing funds disbursed to the merchant for captured orders within a date range.
A monetary value represented as an integer amount in the smallest currency unit (cents) paired with an ISO-4217 currency code.
Indicates whether an order or session is for AUTH (authorize only, capture later) or CAPTURE (authorize and capture immediately).
The financing schedule offered to the shopper. Sezzle supports 4-pay biweekly (default), 4-pay monthly, and 6-pay monthly plans.
The current state of a checkout session: active (pending shopper action), completed, deleted, or denied.
A confirmed approval from Sezzle that a shopper has sufficient credit for a given order amount. Authorizations have an expiration date-time after which reauthorization is required.
The act of settling a previously authorized order, triggering the actual transfer of funds. A partial capture releases the remaining authorized amount.
Cancellation of an authorized (but not yet captured) amount on an order, returning the credit to the shopper.
Return of funds to a shopper for a previously captured order, in whole or in part.
Creation of a new authorization for an expired order. Returns a new order UUID that replaces the original for subsequent API operations.

An additional charge against an existing order, creating a standalone Pay In Full order for up to 15% of the parent order amount. The upcharge is independent from the parent order for capture, refund, and settlement.
The process of storing a shopper's Sezzle credentials for future merchant-initiated payments without requiring the shopper to re-authenticate at checkout.
A check against a tokenized customer's Sezzle account to determine whether a given order amount would be approved before creating the order.
The process by which Sezzle disburses merchant earnings. Settlement summaries and details are available via the Reports endpoints.
A Sezzle-managed account that accumulates interest on merchant balances, queryable for balance and activity history.
A client-generated UUID passed in the Sezzle-Request-Id request header to enforce idempotency on mutating operations such as capture, refund, and reauthorize.
A short-lived JWT obtained via the /authentication endpoint using the merchant's public and private API keys. Required in the Authorization header for all subsequent API calls.
A named event type that triggers webhook delivery. Supported events: customer.tokenized, order.authorized, order.captured, order.refunded.
